title: Image dropzone
description: Learners place labels onto zones laid over an image, then check their answer.
demoHtml:
<image-dropzone src="https://cdn.hax.cloud/cdn/build/es6/node_modules/@haxtheweb/image-dropzone/lib/page-wireframe.svg" alt="Wireframe of a web page with five empty regions" media-title="Page wireframe" question="Label the page regions" maxAttempts="3" randomize>
  <input type="checkbox" value="<header>" data-zone="Top band" data-x="3" data-y="12.3" data-width="94" data-height="13.8">
  <input type="checkbox" value="<nav>" data-zone="Left column" data-x="3" data-y="29.2" data-width="22.5" data-height="52.3">
  <input type="checkbox" value="<main>" data-zone="Center column" data-x="27.5" data-y="29.2" data-width="47.5" data-height="52.3">
  <input type="checkbox" value="<aside>" data-zone="Right column" data-x="77" data-y="29.2" data-width="20" data-height="52.3">
  <input type="checkbox" value="<footer>" data-zone="Bottom band" data-x="3" data-y="84.6" data-width="94" data-height="11.5">
  <input type="checkbox" value="<section>">
</image-dropzone>

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Address of the image the zones sit on

attributes.name: media-title
attributes.description: Visible title of the image; never taken from alt

gizmo.title: Image dropzone
gizmo.description: Learners place labels onto zones laid over an image, then check their answer.

configure.title: Image
configure.description: The image learners place labels on.

configure.title: Alternative text
configure.description: Describes the image for people who cannot see it. Do not give away where the labels go.

configure.title: Image title
configure.description: A short visible title for the image, shown above it.

configure.title: Question
configure.description: What learners are asked to do with the labels.

configure.title: Labels and zones
configure.description: Each item is a label learners can place. Give a label a zone name to put its zone on the image; a label with no zone name is an extra that belongs nowhere. Zone numbers are percentages of the image.

properties.title: Zone name
properties.description: What screen readers call this label's zone, such as Top band. Describe where it is, not what goes there. Leave empty for an extra label.

properties.title: Left (%)
properties.description: Distance of the zone from the left edge of the image.

properties.title: Top (%)
properties.description: Distance of the zone from the top edge of the image.

configure.title: Caption
configure.description: Optional caption shown below the image.

advanced.title: Attempts
advanced.description: How many times a learner can check. 0 means unlimited.

advanced.title: Shuffle labels
advanced.description: Show the labels in a different order each visit.

advanced.title: Collapsible
advanced.description: Show this question as a row that opens and closes. Opening one closes the other collapsible questions beside it.

advanced.title: Start collapsed
advanced.description: When collapsible, start as a closed row that shows only the question and its status.

advanced.title: Grading format
advanced.description: OER Schema: grading format for this assessment (e.g. points, letter, percent, completion).

advanced.title: Learning objective
advanced.description: OER Schema: learning objective associated with this assessment.

developer.title: Name of the quiz
developer.description: Quiz name used for xAPI identification in analytics systems.

developer.title: Course
developer.description: OER Schema: course this assessment is intended for.
